subject: general
question:
Four words of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains a spelling error.

Human activities that __release__ longlived greenhouse gases into the atmosphere also __leed__ to the enhancement of __concentrations__ of shorterlived ozone and __particulate__ matter in the atmosphere.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"leed"** is incorrect. The correct spelling should be **"lead."** "Leed" does not have a recognized meaning in English. (लीड)

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: The new policy will **lead** to better environmental outcomes.
 
 
 
• **"Lead"** means to cause or result in a particular outcome or to be in charge or command of something. (नेतृत्व करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Correct: The new policy will **lead** to better environmental outcomes.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is **lead**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Concentrations** (संगठन): The amount of a substance in a given area or volume.

 
 
• **Example:** The **concentrations** of pollutants in the river have significantly decreased.
 
 
 
• **Particulate** (कण): Relating to or in the form of minute separate particles.
 
 
• **Example:** **Particulate** matter in the air can cause respiratory problems.
 
 
 
• **Release** (रिहाई): To set free or let go.
 
 
• **Example:** The company will **release** a new product next month.
